freezeRule: Freeze this exact file and all input/build/axis hashes before calculating any return; changed parameters require a new declared round, never overwrite this registration.

rankSource.universe: All baseline and rank-neighbor RPS values are recomputed on the SAME frozen CSI800 price-input cross section; NEVER mix historical 5564-market baseline RPS with 799-pool neighbors.
rankSource.computation: Reuse quant-rps rankReturns (1-based mean ties) on actual calendar-aligned endpoint returns for every registered period. Every endpoint must exist with positive turnover; no price/constant fill. Freeze eligible symbols and missing inputs per date/period before evaluation. Current constituent/local price coverage bias is explicit.
rankSource.oldRpsSnapshots: Do not read the old 20/50/120-only external.rps as new rank evidence. Missing registered periods is a data gap, never an economic no-trade or stable neighbor.
rankSource.resource: One shared read-only source parse, stream one date x period cross section; persist compact per-symbol rank arrays under the registered cache budget and bind source/pool/period/calendar hashes.

counting.primary: All 120 main and valid neighbors enter their market x sleeve DSR/CSCV pool on one common OOS daily axis. Effective N is computed after complete OOS series exist.
counting.schemaNoop: The 8 rounded cooldown neighbors equal the parent before execution, are NOT in 120, and are not run. Listed separately below.
counting.executionNoop: Identical full trade lists are only detectable after execution. Preserve their result/audit rows, mark stability untestable, deduplicate exact trials for effective N per lifecycle-2; never presume no-op from similar rule labels.
counting.stress: Each of 120 configurations runs base, double all commission/minimum commission/tax/slippage costs, and discretionary one-bar delay. 360 planned runs; stress scenarios are gates, not independently selectable candidates. If a stress scenario is ever selected as a candidate it must enter DSR as another trial.
counting.terminalAccounting: Not a candidate search; missing terminal evidence blocks trusted returns. Any required last-close/total-loss sensitivity is explicitly labelled accounting and not used to choose winners; source-only applicability is frozen before execution.
counting.noSearch: No Cartesian combinations, no new mains, no result-driven parameter tuning. Fixed user capital/industry/heat/brake thresholds are governance constraints, not optimization dimensions.

cnSwing.source: Frozen classic input commonStart / final completed source week; all 47 configurations use exactly this tradable daily axis before split.
cnSwing.longerSignalHistory: diagnostic only, no additional selectable trial

cnLowZone.primary: sh000300 from 2005, only after declared causal warmup and constituent/valuation coverage; no fake early-cycle completeness
cnLowZone.diagnostic: longer sh000001, separate diagnostic, not another candidate

crypto.intradayLabels: END label: group by completion-1ms; 4h complete day requires 04/08/12/16/20/next00, no missing component or zero fill
crypto.start: Per market x sleeve family, maximum earliest source-complete date after every declared main/neighbor warmup (including 61 complete daily closes for 60 returns); computed from source coverage ONLY, before any equity/return run.
crypto.end: Minimum last full UTC day across every required symbol/period/benchmark, capped at 2026-11-13; source-only intersection is frozen with exact dates and input hash before returns.
crypto.missing: Do not shorten OOS axes after viewing results or impute zero. Any missing required day makes evidence incomplete, preserving the declared axis.

split.holdoutStartRule: last 20 percent of frozen family daily axis; rolling OOS on preceding 80 percent, identical windows for all family trials

sourcePolicy.cnUniverse: The original frozen CSI800 current-constituent price pool, explicitly survivorship biased; any later delisting audit/industry source must be hashed and labelled, not treated as PIT.
sourcePolicy.cryptoUniverse: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT ONLY, matching current authorized scope. Freeze both original native-period Binance source hashes before family coverage intersection. Old 20-pair runs remain historical comparisons, not new candidates or trials.
sourcePolicy.industry: CN current labels allowed only with current-industry-lookahead source/hash; crypto has no default industry cap. Correlation uses same-industry OR rho>=0.8 connected groups and 3% planned-stop equity risk, explicit strategy config.
sourcePolicy.lowValuation: Aggregate positive market-cap coverage >=60% separately for PE/PB, trailing <=30th percentile, actual PIT announcement availability; missing history is unknown, never zero or today's values backfilled.

resources.sourceReads: Read-only shared frozen source, parse once per heavy process; no per-trial copies or parallel heavy processes.
resources.checkpoint: Atomic content-addressed per configuration/scenario manifest only after exact input/config/build/axis hash binding. Resume only matching identities; at most one active run. Keep compact daily arrays/trade returns plus actual fill evidence for selected final candidate; never fabricate distributions from summaries.
resources.budgetStop: Stop cleanly before projected disk budget, heap exhaustion or source mismatch. Preserve raw inputs/manifests. Do not prune raw/active evidence to continue.
resources.actualReturnRun: NOT AUTHORIZED until engineering/oracle/distribution and this frozen registration pass manager review.
